messages:
noah_new: hey team — first day here! laptop arrived but FileVault shows off. do i enable encryption myself or will IT push it? also how do i get access to the dev KMS key for local sops testing? any security training i should knock out today? tagging @lisa_peopleops and @jamie_security

lisa_peopleops: welcome aboard :tada: — congrats! do NOT enable FileVault manually yet. we push an MDM profile that enables FileVault and escrows the recovery key. we'll schedule the IT handoff in ~1h. please keep the laptop plugged in until then.

ops-it: hi Noah — can you paste output of `fdesetup status` and `sw_vers` so i can confirm image version?

noah_new: sure, output below:
```
$ fdesetup status
FileVault is Off
```
macOS 13.6.1

jamie_security: thanks. since FileVault is off we'll trigger a re-enroll + FileVault enable from MDM. @ops-it will push that and you'll likely see a dialog to restart and allow full disk encryption. for KMS: dev access is via an Okta group that maps to the `redwood-dev-kms` IAM role. i'll DM the link for the self-serve request.

noah_new: got it — thanks. quick Q on phishing sims: i think i saw an email but not sure which cohort i'm in. do new hires have a separate schedule?

security-bot: PhishSim: new-user cohort scheduled 2026-03-25 10:00 UTC. Completion window: 7 days. Reminder emails will go out automatically.

maya-eng: if you need to decrypt local secrets while waiting for KMS, use our local dev flow with sops + the shared dev key (only available after KMS access). example snippet: `export SOPS_KMS=\"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01\"\nsops -d secrets.enc.yaml > secrets.yaml`

lisa_peopleops: also a reminder: new hires need to finish Security Foundations course in Okta Learning within 72h. here's the self-serve link: https://okta.redwood.local/learn/security-foundations (DM me if you don't see it).

ops-it: i'm about to push the re-enroll now. expect a command-line prompt and a restart. if you see any permission popups, screenshot and post here. i'll confirm when the FileVault escrow is created.

noah_new: thanks — i'll stay by my laptop. one more thing: i installed VS Code on personal machine earlier; is that allowed for dev work?

jamie_security: permitted for UI/local editing, but don't sync corp repos to personal cloud drives. if you use extensions that access networks (sync, settings sync), disable them or use a corp profile. keep corp secrets only on company machine until you have KMS and corp-approved backups. :lock:

noah_new: makes sense, thanks everyone — appreciate the quick responses!

ops-it: FileVault enable job submitted. i'll post an update in ~5 mins.

security-bot: Reminder: please complete MFA enrollment within 24h to avoid access delays.

ops-it: update: MDM re-enroll started at 1779123750. you should see the enable FileVault dialog now.

noah_new: saw it, going to reboot now. will report back if anything odd. thanks again!
